name: Container freight
summary: Drewry container index $4,429, above the $4,000 Alert line
state: Drewry's World Container Index fell 3% to $4,429 per 40ft container on 29 Oct, still above the $4,000 Alert line, as transpacific rates slid on weaker US import demand (Drewry; Fibre2Fashion). Gulf disruption and rerouting keep capacity tight. The next reading is due on 5 Nov.
for_you: High freight rates raise costs for importers and can feed into shop prices over coming months, especially for goods shipped from Asia.
basis_detail: Drewry World Container Index / Freightos Baltic Index
basis_by: Drewry World Container Index / Freightos Baltic Index

sources.title: Fibre2Fashion — Drewry WCI falls as US import demand weakens

why: Container rates feed through to goods prices months later; spikes are an early inflation and supply-chain warning.
drivers: Chokepoint diversions, capacity, demand, port congestion, tariffs front-running.

rubric.normal: Drewry World Container Index < $2,500/FEU and 1-month change < +30%.
